metadata.title: Closed-Loop Artificial Pancreas Model Predictive Control under Exercise
metadata.sim_type: Minimal Bergman Model with Exercise-Induced Transport

metadata.description: Fixed basal insulin infusion. Highly vulnerable to postprandial hyperglycemia and exercise-induced hypoglycemia.
Proportional-Integral-Derivative controller. Reactive feedback with lag, struggling during rapid onset of exercise.
Receding horizon MPC with exercise awareness, dynamically regulating insulin to safeguard against exercise crash.
